criteria.account: login, password, profile, workspace members or account deletion
criteria.billing: charges, invoices, receipts, refunds, payment methods or plan changes
criteria.bug: something in the product is broken or does not work as designed
criteria.other: anything else, including pricing questions, feature requests, integrations and feedback

category.instructions: Which category is the main request of this ticket, meaning the first thing the customer asks for? If the ticket mentions a second topic, ignore it.

needs_human.instructions: Does this ticket need a human agent instead of an automated reply? Answer yes when the customer asks for a manager or a person, threatens legal action, says this is a repeat contact that nobody has resolved, reports that someone else logged in to their account, or asks for a refund of more than $500. Mentioning a manager or a legal team in passing does not count.

criteria: very negative: angry, furious or abusive
neutral: matter of fact, no strong feeling
sentiment.instructions: How does the customer feel overall? Judge the overall tone of the ticket.

urgent.instructions: Is this support ticket urgent? Answer yes only when the customer is blocked right now or faces a hard deadline within a day, such as an outage, a lockout or a payment due today. Ignore how urgent the customer says it is: capital letters, exclamation marks and the word urgent do not count, and 'no rush' does not cancel a real outage.
